content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Bilaspur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://www.aiimsbilaspur.edu.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 31-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Bilaspur Faculty Posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Faculty Posts at AIIMS Bilaspur is 31-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Faculty Posts at AIIMS Bilaspur?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 vacancies available for Faculty Posts at AIIMS Bilaspur.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General/OBC candidates is Rs. 2360/-. SC/ST candidates are exempted from the application fee.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Faculty posts is 58 years, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for AIIMS Bilaspur Faculty Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes scrutiny of applications, a personal interview, and a presentation before the Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the starting salary for the Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The starting basic salary for Assistant Professor posts is Rs. 1,01,500/- per month, as per Pay Matrix 12.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any age relaxation for government servants applying for these posts?
faq.answer: Yes, Centre Government Servants are eligible for an age relaxation of 5 years.

faq.question: Q8. What is the official website for AIIMS Bilaspur?
faq.answer: The official website for AIIMS Bilaspur is https://www.aiimsbilaspur.edu.in.

faq.question: Q9. What are the required qualifications for the Faculty posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must be registered with the State Medical Council/MCI/NMC, and specific qualifications are detailed in Annexure-A of the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates apply through online mode?
faq.answer: No, the application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their application form to the official address mentioned in the notification.
